description: Generic hierarchical tree component rendering ITreeNode<TKey> items with expand/collapse toggles, click-to-select labels, lazy loading spinners, and recursive child rendering.

parameters.name: OnNodeSelect
parameters.description: Fires when a tree node label is clicked.

parameters.name: OnNodeExpand
parameters.description: Fires when a tree node is expanded or collapsed.

parameters.name: AllowDrop
parameters.description: When true, tree nodes accept drops from external drag sources (e.g. TmMultiViewList).

parameters.name: OnItemsDrop
parameters.description: Fires when external items (e.g. from TmMultiViewList) are dropped onto a tree node. Provides the target node and dragged IDs.

parameters.name: AllowNodeDrag
parameters.description: When true, tree nodes themselves can be dragged to reparent them within the tree.

parameters.name: OnNodeMove
parameters.description: Fires when a node is dropped onto another node or the root drop zone. NewParent is null when the node is promoted to root level.

examples.title: Tree with expand callback for lazy loading
Tree accepting drops from TmMultiViewList
examples.code:
<TmTreeView TKey="string"
            Nodes="@_suites"
            AllowDrop="true"
            OnItemsDrop="HandleItemsDrop" />

@code {
    private async Task HandleItemsDrop(TreeDropEventArgs<string> args)
    {
        // args.TargetNode — the node that was dropped onto
        // args.DraggedIds — IDs of the dragged items
        await MoveItemsToSuiteAsync(args.DraggedIds, args.TargetNode.Id);
    }
}

examples.title: Tree with node drag-and-drop to reparent nodes
examples.code:
<TmTreeView TKey="string"
            Nodes="@_suites"
            AllowNodeDrag="true"
            OnNodeMove="HandleNodeMove" />

@code {
    private async Task HandleNodeMove(TreeNodeMoveEventArgs<string> args)
    {
        // args.MovedNode  — the node that was dragged
        // args.NewParent  — null when promoted to root
        await ReparentAsync(args.MovedNode.Id, args.NewParent?.Id);
        _suites = await LoadTreeAsync();
    }
}

examples.title: Tree with both AllowDrop and AllowNodeDrag (Test Suite Manager pattern)
examples.code:
<TmTreeView TKey="string"
            Nodes="@_suites"
            AllowDrop="true"
            AllowNodeDrag="true"
            OnNodeSelect="HandleSuiteSelect"
            OnItemsDrop="HandleItemsDrop"
            OnNodeMove="HandleNodeMove" />
